title: RomskModiPack
description: Optimizing and adding new feautures to Minecraft
body:
# RomskModiPack
> It is a Minecraft modpack for optimization and improving gameplay. Is was originally based on Fabsoluty Optimized.


## Features
This modpack adds many convenient, useful and just cool mods and resource packs, such as:
1. Faithful 32x. I think it is cool to have 32x textures.
2. Mini- and World map, AppleScin, REI. These are really important mods that make game easier.
3. A lot of mods that improves visual of Minecraft: Better Statistics Screen, Better Tab, etc.
4. Flashback. Good mod for Minecraft youtubers.
5. Optimization mods: Sodium, Lithium, C2ME, Entity Culling, etc.


## Optimization
I ran a test where I generated the same world in vanilla Minecraft and in RomskModiPack.
> My PC's characteristics: CPU - Intel Core I5 7500, GPU - Intel Graphics HD 630, Minecraft was running with 4gb RAM; seed was -4773392955949060722.

While loading chunks on RomskModiPack, the frame rate was around 100 fps with drops to 40; after loading the chunks, the frame rate remained at around 120 fps.

On vanilla, while loading chunks, the frame rate was around 30 fps with drops to 5, after loading chunks, the frame rate remained at around 80 fps.

And this shows the benefits of my modpack and why you should download it =D.


## Important note
The modpack requires a Java version greater than 22 because it is contains the C2ME mod.
